title: How long assistant conversations and usage records are kept
question: How long should assistant chats, their archived transcripts and the per-call usage records be kept, can a user or company delete them, and should a chat hidden from the list after 7 days still be stored?
context: Working memory lasts 15 minutes, the chat archive is never deleted but is listed for 7 days (AI-REQ-004), and the usage ledger is permanent (AI-REQ-024). Account deletion rules (DEC-015) do not mention assistant data.
